# netactuate_image (Resource)

Manages an Image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_image" "example" {
  name      = "example"
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the custom image
- `server_id` (Number) Source server ID (mbpkgid) to create the image from

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the custom image
- `keep_ssh_userdirs` (Boolean) Whether to preserve SSH user directories in the image

### Read-Only

- `bits` (String) Architecture (32 or 64)
- `category` (String) OS category (e.g. ubuntu, centos)
- `created` (String) Creation timestamp
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image_type` (String) Image type
- `os_enabled` (Number) Image status: 1=enabled, 0=disabled
- `script_bash` (Boolean) Whether the image supports bash scripts
- `script_cloudinit` (Boolean) Whether the image supports cloud-init
- `size` (String) Image size
- `subtype` (String) Image subtype
- `tech` (String) Virtualization technology

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_image.example 12345
```
